name: Dumbbell Half-Kneeling Shoulder Press
steps: Assume a half-kneeling position on a mat with your right knee on the floor directly under your hip and left foot flat in front.
Hold a dumbbell in your right hand at shoulder height, with elbow pointing forward at roughly a 45-degree angle.
Squeeze your right glute and engage your core to lock your pelvis in place and prevent lower back arching.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is fully extended with your bicep near your ear.
Lower the dumbbell with control back to shoulder height, completing all reps before switching sides.
coaching_cues: The half-kneeling position locks your pelvis and prevents you from arching your lower back to cheat the weight overhead.
Press in the scapular plane (elbow angled 30 to 45 degrees forward), not flared out wide.
Keep the front knee stacked over the front heel.
